'''Sensor Relay Satellites''' were a model of [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] that could be tied into a standard [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor array]], such as the [[9954/I Sensor Array|9954/I]]. The satellites cost two thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and allowed the sensor array to pick up readings beyond near-[[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].<ref name="HS" />
